name: 権限チェック項目から設定するロール作成フォーム
prompt:
Create a tall, compact Jira custom-role creation form image based closely on the supplied reference crop, matching its approximately 763:1055 aspect ratio. Use a plain white modal/form surface with a subtle neutral border and no tinted panels. Preserve the visible form state exactly.
Top: heading “Create role”. Required field “Name *” with value “QA Reviewer”. Required field “Description *” with value “Responsible for reviewing completed issues before they are marked as approved.”
Then heading “People in this role can:” and a vertically scrollable permission list with all visible checkboxes empty/unchecked. Show these visible rows in order:
• “Administer \"Mobbin Web Team\"” with description “Edit access, manage people and permissions, configure issue types and their fields, enable project features, and delete the project.”
• Expanded “Manage \"Mobbin Web Team\" issues” with description “Modify reporters and watchers, edit and delete any comments and attachments, adjust work log entries, and delete \"Mobbin Web Team\" issues.” Show a small slate up-chevron at its right.
• Indented child “Add or remove issue watchers” with description “Add or remove people from the list of watchers on any \"Mobbin Web Team\" issue.”
• Indented child “Delete any attachment” with description “Delete the attachments added by anyone on any \"Mobbin Web Team\" issue.”
• At the bottom, show the beginning of “Delete any comment” and its description only as far as the reference visibly shows; let the fixed assignment/footer region cover the rest, preserving the clipped/scrolling state. Do not invent hidden content or extra permissions.
Fixed lower area, separated by a thin neutral divider: heading “Assign this role to:”, label “Name, email or group”, a white search input with exact placeholder “e.g. Maria, maria@company.com” and a neutral slate search icon. At bottom right show primary “Create” and secondary “Discard”.
Use ink #1D1D1D, secondary text #6E6E6E, neutral slate icons and unchecked boxes #526173, white surfaces, light neutral separators. Apply only the official Lighthouse gradient to the primary Create button at 135 degrees (#174C36 0%, #1F6444 58%, #2D8F5E 100%). No tint colors, blue controls, color washes, glow, selected checkboxes, extra copy, or navigation. Keep all typography readable and match the source's compact tall layout.
reviewNotes: Reviewed v1 against the saved 763x1055 source crop. Preserves QA Reviewer name and description, unchecked permission list with the expanded Manage group, visible nested rows and clipped Delete any comment row, plus the fixed assignment/search footer. White surfaces, slate controls, required-field markers, official gradient only on Create; no tint. Static candidate review only.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
